_source: Stock Unlimited, 'Market Structure + Fibo + Doubts' class (SBI Life, Reliance, Nifty 15-min). Edit numbers here, not in code.

risk._min_sl: Signals whose SL is closer than this are skipped (29-Sep replay: a 2-point SL). Set 0 to switch off.

fib._rule: After a CLOSE above the high (the 348 level example) the market tries to reach Fib 1.2 / 1.4 of the leg - in one day or two. Draw high->low for upside targets; after a CHoCH down draw low->high for downside targets. Book most at the previous high, the rest at the Fib level. He prefers futures charts for drawing (next-month futures open at a premium after the monthly expiry) (4:00-8:30, 33:40-34:55).

imbalance_hold._rule: Only the LATEST 3-candle imbalance (1-2-3). A candle trades into it, may even go below it, but CLOSES back in the zone -> buy, SL = that candle's low, target 1.2 (or at least the recent high). A close below = no trade (sometimes you miss it when a long wick makes R:R bad). Once a newer imbalance is respected, trail the SL to it. Mirror for sells. Use this and double bottoms when the 15-min order blocks are far away (35:24-39:25, 44:32-45:44, 1:00:30-1:00:50).

notes._carry: Almost never carry forward, especially option buys; intraday gives buy and sell setups every day (34:55-35:24).
notes._expiry: Monthly-expiry +-300 straddle repeated (50:47-55:24): already in mentor_extras (low India VIX 11-13, ~50 pts OTM, exit both legs together). New: if neither side is hit by Wednesday and price hovers near one side, a small extra put/call for Thursday - he calls it 'tukka' (luck) trading.
notes._stocks: Stocks (SBI Life): structure from a comfortable point, inducement can be taken by a wick, keep first and last OB only, SL = daily CLOSE below the OB. Fundamentals before buying: rising quarterly/annual profit, reserves > borrowings, positive operating cash flow, working-capital days, promoters steady, FII/DII rising, public falling.
notes._fii: FII net stocks cumulative in the sheet can differ from NSDL (NSDL comes a day later). They keep buying stock futures on dips; the portfolio is safe until that data empties (~1-1.5 lakh) near a top.
